evidence_notes: Read-only audit of Claude Opus 5.5 on ~125k-parameter CNNs, no tools; 'We do not test weight editing' (p3) and editing runs were stopped (p13), so mechanism is none. Scoring criteria were written in a project log before prompts but 'were not publicly preregistered' and no timestamps/hashes are reported (p7), coded none; Claude Code assigned scores and implemented the pipeline (p7, p16); materials only on request (p16). Shuffled-weight and label-permutation controls exist (p8); most configurations run once on one seed (p14); familiar-dataset fallback is the main failure (p1).
